name: Imai Kokoro
source:
A childish girl who goes to the same school as Minamo, she has a bright and cheerful personality but is somewhat spoiled. Like Minamo, she's in love with Satoru and tries her best to win him over. As such, Kokoro and Minamo eventually become fierce love rivals.

Her best friends are two hamsters which she sometimes throws at people (mostly at Minamo).
